prompt: Vert.x CSRFHandler session aware token regeneration condition
answer: For a session-aware `CSRFHandler`, the token is regenerated **only when the session is upgraded**. If there is no session, a new token is issued on every request; otherwise, the token is stored in the session and reused. The stored value includes the session ID so a session upgrade invalidates the previous token.
